# Content Piece

## Summary
One thing that publishes once, on one platform, at one time — the atomic unit of
the Content Calendar. Everything else in the app is a way of grouping or
scheduling these.

## Composition
- `platform` and `status` are option-set fields, not strings: the calendar's
  colour mapping and the status filter both key off the stored value, and a
  hand-typed "Youtube" would break each of them silently.
- `scheduledAt` is a `DateTimeField` because a post has a time of day. Store it
  so the intended *local* time lands on the intended date — in UTC+8 an 18:00
  clock-face authored as UTC lands on tomorrow, and day placement is the one
  thing a calendar has to get right.
- `handedTo` links a Freelancer. Null means the work is the creator's own; there
  is no separate "assignee" concept, because there is only one person.
- `sourceIdea` and `series` record where the piece came from — a backlog idea
  that got scheduled, or an occurrence a cadence produced.

## Formats
`fitted` leads with the platform mark and the title, revealing the date, then the
status pill, then the handed-to line as height allows. `embedded` is a row with
the status pill inline. `isolated` is the brief plus a facts grid.

## Non-goals
No publishing, no analytics, no per-platform character counting. The piece
records intent and state; the posting happens in the platform's own app.
